race.title: Francis McGee Memorial Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: HEY NOW shaped well on his return when fourth at Wexford and with this longer trip a likely big plus, he edges the vote in this highly competitive handicap. Magic Day could emerge as the main danger on the back of a promising Navan sixth, although a clutch of others also need considering, including Fairlander , Dont Go Yet and Euro Agent . HEY NOW MAGIC DAY (IRE) FAIRLANDER (IRE)
